description: Store a file at a path in an inbox's drive (Agent Drive) and get it back ready, with a download link when the credential may read files. Give text as content, or base64 with encoding base64 for any other bytes. Retrying the identical call returns the same file. A path holds one file: uploading something different to a path whose file is ready fails, so delete it first or pick another path. Files count against the organization's quota (1 GiB and 10,000 files by default); a refusal says which limit. Agent Drive is in AgentMail Labs (US only); an organization outside Labs gets a 403. Through this server a call is at most 10 MB, so a file sent as base64 can be about 7 MB at most.

content.description: The file's content: plain text, or base64 when encoding is base64

contentType.description: MIME type, e.g. application/pdf; text/plain; charset=utf-8 for utf8 content and application/octet-stream for base64 when omitted

encoding.description: utf8 when content is the text itself, base64 for any other bytes (a PDF, an image)

expiresAt.description: When the file deletes itself, as ISO 8601 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z); in the future. It never expires when omitted

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

path.description: Where the file goes in the inbox's drive, e.g. reports/q3.pdf: segments separated by /, no leading or trailing /. A path holds one file; its last segment is the name a download saves under
